text: よわいてきは　そのもようを　みただけで　にげだしてしまう。

structure.jp: そのもようを　みただけで

patterns.name: 〜だけで
patterns.explanation: だけで after a past verb means 'just by doing that, and nothing more'. みただけで = 'just from seeing it'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, without being able to help it. にげだしてしまう = 'end up running away'.
